verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a SaaS work-management tool like Trello, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention settings, deletion controls, or data export or purge features. Community reports of accounts or boards being lost describe involuntary data loss or support-driven deletion, not a user-controllable retention or deletion capability, so they do not count as support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
